paite: Huai khit in Samuel in sathau bawm lakhia in alu ah asung a, atawp a, "TOUPA'N agoutante tung a heutu ding a sathau hon nilh ahi kei maw?
heading: Saul Thaunilhna
english: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t Yahweh anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?

paite: Tuni a na hon nutsiat chiang in Zelzah ah Benjamin gamgi a Rakil han kiang ah mi nih na mu dia; amau na kiang ah, 'Na sabiltung zonte amuta uh. Ngai in, na pa'n sabiltungte lungkhampih nawn lou in, nang hon lungkhampihta hi. Ka tapa a ding in bang ka hih dia, chichi ahi, achi ding uh'.
english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

paite: Huai a pan pai zel inla, Tabor tosaw na va tung ding a, huai ah mi thum Bethel a Pathian kiang a hohtou dingte'n hon na kituahpih ding uh. Khat in kelnou apom dia, khat in tanghou pek khal thum atawi dia, khat in uain thawl atawi ding hi.
english: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.

paite: "Chibai ahon buk ding ua, tanghou pek khal nih ahon pe ding ua; huai na la ding ahi.
english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.

paite: Huai khit in Philistia sepaihte omna Pathian mual na va tung ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai khua na va tun chiang in zawlnei pawl khat ama ua pekgingte, khuangtate, tamngaite leh kaihgingte tawimi pawl toh mun sang a pan hong paikhesuk na tuak dia, amaute'n thu agen ding uhi.
english: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.

paite: Na tung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung ding a, nang leng amau toh thu na gen dia, huchi in mituam na suak ding hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.

paite: " 'Hiai chiamtehnate na tung a ahong tun chiang in, thil hong om in azil dungzui in na hih ding ahi. Pathian lah na kiang ah a-om ngal a.
english: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.

paite: Kei ma in Gilgal ah hohsuk in. Ngai in, kei leng halmang thillatte leh lemna kithoihnate lan ding in na kiang ah ka hong suk ding.' Na kiang a ka hong a, na hih ding ka hon hilh ma ni sagih na taam ding," achi hi.
english: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”

paite: Huchibang ahong hi ngei a, Samuel paisan dia anungngattak in Pathian in lungtang dang apeta hi. Huai chiamtehna tengteng huai ni in ahong tung vek hi.
english: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.

paite: Huchi in mual ahong tun uleh, ngai in, zawlneite'n ana kituahpih uhi. Atung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung a, athugenna uah amah leng atel samta hi.
english: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, tuma lam a amah ana theisate'n zawlneite thugenna ah atel sam chih atheih un, akihou ua, "Kish tapa tung a thil hong om bangchidan ahita a? Saul leng zawlneite lak a tel samta ahi maw?" akichi uhi.
english: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”

paite: A-omna khua ua mi khat in adawng a, "Apa uh kua ahi tuan a ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Saul leng zawlnei ahi samta maw? chih paunak ahong hita hi.
english: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

paite: Athugen khit in mun sang atungta hi.
english: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.

paite: Saul paneu in akiang ah leh asikha kiang ah, "Koi a hoh na hi ua?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sabiltung zong ka hi uh. Ka muh zoh louh ziak un Samuel kiang ah ka va hoh uhi," achi hi.
english: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”

paite: Saul paneu in, "Samuel in na kiang ua bang ahia agen hon hilh dih," achi hi.
english: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

paite: Saul in apaneu kiang ah, "Sabengtungte amuta uh chih ahon hilh hi,” achi hi. Himahleh lalgam thu Samuel in agen pen ahilh kei hi.
english: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in mipite Mizpah ah TOUPA mai ah asamkhawm hi.
heading: Saul Kumpipa A Puan Ahi
english: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;

paite: Huai ah Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte Aigupta a pan ka pikhia a, Aigupta mite khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah gam tengteng a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.
english: and he said to the children of Israel, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

paite: Himahleh tuni in na mangbatna tengteng uleh na gimthuakna tengteng ua kipan nou hon humbitpa na Pathian uh na deih kei uh. Akiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpipa hon bawlsak in,' na chi uh. Huaiziak in tu in anam a nam leh achi a chỉ in TOUPA ma ah hong kilang un" achi hi.
english: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes and by your thousands.”

paite: Huchi a Samuel in Israel chi tengteng ahong kilat naisaktak in Benjamin chitel ahong hita.
english: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

paite: Benjamin chite bel a-inkuankuan in ahong kilak ua, Matri mite inkuan tel ahong hi a, Kish tapa Saul tel ahong hita hi. Amah azon uleh amuzou kei uh.
english: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA adong tuan nawn ua, "Hiai mi hong pai nai lou hiam," achi uh. TOUPA'N adawng a, "Ngai un, van lak ah akibu hi," achi hi.
english: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” Yahweh answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”

paite: Huchi in atai ua, ava pikhia ua, mipi lak a adinleh mi lak ah asangpen a, kuamah aliangzang khengzou a-om kei uhi.
english: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

paite: Samuel in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA miseh na mu uhia? Mi tengteng lak ah amah bang mahmah a-om kei," achi hi. Mite akikou ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
english: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom Yahweh has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in mipite lalgam omdan ding ahilh hi. Laibu ah agelh a, TOUPA ma ah akoih hi. Samuel in mite amau inn chiat ah apaisakta hi.
english: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

paite: Saul leng Gibeah a a-inn ah apai sam hi. Pathian in alungtang uh akhoih mihangsante leng amah toh apaikhawm uhi.
english: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

paite: Himahleh Belial tapate'n, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in ahon hondam thei mahmah dia?" chi in amah angaineu ua, thilpiak ahong pe kei uh. Himahleh amah bel adai dide hi.
english: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.
